summary.ru: Южная Янь — одно из 16 варварских государств, возникших в IV веке на территории Северного Китая. Существовало в 398—410 годах.
summary.en: Yan, known in historiography as the Southern Yan, was a dynastic state of China ruled by the Murong clan of the Xianbei during the era of Sixteen Kingdoms. Its founder Murong De was a son of Murong Huang and brother of Murong Jun and Murong Chui, and therefore was an imperial prince of both the Former Yan and Later Yan dynasties.
